_readme: Copy to .claude/amphion.config.json in YOUR project and edit. Every key is optional: a skill that finds no config falls back to discovery and asks before guessing. Delete the keys you don't use.

core.note: Phased execution order, file-modification map, pointers to per-unit specs.
Resolved decisions. Read BEFORE the specs — knowing what was settled prevents rework.
Optional. Tone/register/naming rules for user-facing copy. Omit for projects with no copy.
Repo-level conventions and the 'when you hit something unexpected' table.
